Shell(cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/logo.py" <<'PY' # Fuente ANSI Shadow (la del proyecto). Cada glifo es una celda de ancho fijo # (mismas columnas en las 6 filas) y se separan con una columna. L = ["██╗ ", "██║ ", "██║ ", "██║ ", "███████╗", "╚══════╝"] O = [" ██████╗ ", "██╔═══██╗", "██║ ██║", "██║ ██║", "╚██████╔╝", " ╚═════╝ "] C = [" ██████╗ ", "██╔════╝ ", "██║ ", "██║ ", "╚██████╗ ", " ╚═════╝ "] A = [" █████╗ ", "██╔══██╗ ", "███████║ ", "██╔══██║ ", "██║ ██║ ", "╚═╝ ╚═╝ "] I = ["██╗", "██║", "██║", "██║", "██║", "╚═╝"] for name, cell in [("L",L),("O",O),("C",C),("A",A),("I",I)]: ws = {len(r) for r in cell} assert len(ws) == 1 and len(cell) == 6, (name, ws) glifos = [L, O, C, A, L, C, L, I] filas = [" ".join(g[r] for g in glifos) for r in range(6)] anchos = {len(f) for f in filas} assert len(anchos) == 1, anchos assert all(f == f.rstrip() for f in filas), "hay espacios finales" print("\n".join(filas)) print("---") print("ancho =", anchos.pop(), "| filas =", len(filas)) PY python3 "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/logo.py")
